objective: Preregister 15 candidates for T-20260929-01 part A (gap-search 2026-09-29-01, flows_structural.rebalance_and_hedging_flows): 12 primary LETF_{SPY,QQQ,SMH}_D{2,3}_H{1,3} close-rebalancing-flow-reversal candidates (down day at close -> next-open buy, hold 1 or 3 days, else cash) plus 3 internal RAND placebo controls (LETF_{SPY,QQQ,SMH}_RAND, frequency-matched deterministic pseudo-random entry days), for scripts/screen_batch.py --batch h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal --iteration h20260929_01_letf_flow_reversal. No return, Sharpe or backtest number is computed in this dossier.

keep_rule.K1: date-neutral Sharpe (D freq, single version) >= 0.80 * S3's date-neutral Sharpe in BOTH windows (anchor >=1.1882, stress >=0.6447), 10bp per side, positive CAGR at 20bp. 12 primary candidates only.
keep_rule.K2: a 63-session trailing-inverse-vol monthly blend of the candidate with S3 beats a vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control by >=0.05 Sharpe in BOTH windows. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.watch_recent: anchor-window date-neutral Sharpe >= 1.1882 but stress does not clear its bar -- forward-tracked only. Primary candidates only.
keep_rule.strong_keep: K2 edge >= 0.10 in both windows, or K1's Sharpe in both windows is >= S3's own (1.4853 anchor / 0.8059 stress).
keep_rule.placebo_internal_falsification: a primary LETF_{TICKER}_D2_H1 candidate otherwise kept is demoted to not_kept if its same-ticker RAND placebo's anchor Sharpe >= its own anchor Sharpe.
keep_rule.pass_requires: K1 OR K2, primary candidates only, subject to placebo demotion.
keep_rule.multiple_comparisons: This iteration's own n_trials=15 (12 primary + 3 placebo). Full 27-candidate family (joint with sibling h20260929_01_dip_rejudge) DSR computed manually in report.md.
